					change_variable = { name = te_dg_rs_$SIDE$_f3 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rs_amt multiply = { value = local_var:te_dg_rs_lf multiply = 0.02 add = 0.066 } } }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = te_dg_rs_$SIDE$_f3 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_rs_amt multiply = { value = local_var:te_dg_rs_lf multiply = 0.02 add = 0.066 } } }

				else = {

		}

			if = {

# THIS = a state at its census step, holding counters (te_demog_rs_take). Each class and sex's arrivals
# (te_dg_rk_g<s><c>) and departures (te_dg_rk_d<s><c>) over its last-year sum (var:te_dg_c<s><c>); Rustication's
# over the people at its ages (te_dg_rk_gy<s>, te_dg_rk_dy<s>; the bands te_dg_b<s>3, te_dg_b<s>4); what a class or the youth's ages with under
# one person can't take, at one flat rate over every class with people (te_dg_rk_gflat, te_dg_rk_dflat). No cap:
# a known move is a count (demographics_resettle.known_rates).
te_demog_rs_known_rates = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_all value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_gleft value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_dleft value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_gf0 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_df0 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_dg_cf0 >= 1 }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_all add = var:te_dg_cf0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_gf0 value = { value = var:te_dg_rs_i_f0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf0 min = 1 } } }
		}

			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_df0 value = { value = var:te_dg_rs_o_f0 divide = { value = var:te_dg_cf0 min = 1 } } }

	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_rk_all >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_rk_dflat value = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dleft divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_all min = 1 } } }
	}
}

# THIS = a state in its step's sweep, after te_demog_enter_class, while it holds known moves (local te_dg_rk_on):
# the class's known rates and the flat ones added to its gain and loss shares (te_dg_mig_gain_<s>,
# te_dg_mig_frac_<s>), and Rustication's at rate ages 15-24 (demographics_resettle.Known.rates).
te_demog_rs_enter_class = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cf0 >= 1 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gf0 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_df0 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cm0 >= 1 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gm0 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dm0 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cf1 >= 1 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gf1 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_df1 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_r >= 15 local_var:te_dg_r <= 24 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gyf }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dyf }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:te_dg_cm1 >= 1 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gm1 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dm1 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_r >= 15 local_var:te_dg_r <= 24 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gym }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dym }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf2 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gf2 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_df2 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_r >= 15 local_var:te_dg_r <= 24 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gyf }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dyf }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm2 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gm2 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dm2 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_r >= 15 local_var:te_dg_r <= 24 }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gym }
					change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dym }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_acls <= 3 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf3 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gf3 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_df3 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm3 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gm3 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dm3 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cf4 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gf4 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_f add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_df4 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_dg_cm4 >= 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_gain_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_gm4 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_gflat } }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_mig_frac_m add = { value = local_var:te_dg_rk_dm4 add = local_var:te_dg_rk_dflat } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state in its step's sweep, at every slot while it holds known moves: at a rate age where Rustication's
# rates start or end and no class starts, the class's shares are taken again, so its rates reach exactly its ages.
te_demog_rs_youth_hook = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_dg_r = 25
		}
		te_demog_enter_class = yes
		te_demog_rs_enter_class = yes
	}
}

# THIS = a state: its known-move counters removed (te_demog_rs_take after the step reads them; te_demog_seed, which
# counts the people as they are). Every add also raises one of the three totals, so a state with none has none.
# And the last step's known net (te_dg_rs_net), which te_demog_flows writes again after the take.
te_demog_rs_clear = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_net }
		remove_variable = te_dg_rs_net
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = te_dg_rs_in
				has_variable = te_dg_rs_out
				has_variable = te_dg_rs_dead
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_in }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_in
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_out }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_out
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_dead }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_dead
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f0 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m0 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f1 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m1 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f2 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m2 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f3 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m3 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f4 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_f4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m4 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_m4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_yf }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_yf
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_i_ym }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_i_ym
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f0 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m0 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f1 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m1 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f2 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m2 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f3 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m3 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f4 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_f4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m4 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_m4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_yf }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_yf
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_rs_o_ym }
			remove_variable = te_dg_rs_o_ym
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state the history marks as the US frontier (te_dg_frontier), at its 1836 seed (te_demog_frontier_begin):
# its men per woman at each age group (te_dg_fr_<j>) by its state region, from the 1840 census's free white men
# per 100 women weighted by the region's settler share (demographics_params.FRONTIER_1836).
te_demog_frontier_ratios = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_ALABAMA }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.94471 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.12596 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.14999 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.15336 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.16016 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.11043 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_ARKANSAS }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.99382 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.20344 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.24138 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.26358 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.21651 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.20006 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_FLORIDA }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.99254 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.46831 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.58925 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.35037 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.26023 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.23967 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_ILLINOIS }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 1.03285 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.3507 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.38193 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.24124 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.3405 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.25833 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_INDIANA }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.99183 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.08637 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.14657 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.08461 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.27776 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.23817 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_IOWA }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 1.03001 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.30394 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.35928 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.26422 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.20589 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.22584 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_LOUISIANA }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.95081 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.24643 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.4448 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.40201 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.30795 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.16498 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_MICHIGAN }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 1.00562 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.19168 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.30812 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.31157 }

		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.32157 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.24874 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_MISSOURI }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 0.99116 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.24806 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.333 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.28615 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { state_region = s:STATE_WISCONSIN }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_0 value = 1.09211 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_1 value = 1.90276 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_2 value = 1.91472 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_3 value = 1.66587 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_4 value = 1.39547 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_fr_5 value = 1.39426 }
	}
}

# THIS = a state in its seed's sweep, frontier on (local te_dg_fr_on), after slot $S$'s cohort is written: at an
# age group's ages the cohort's men are its women x the group's ratio (te_dg_fr_<j>; a ratio 0, a region not
# listed, leaves the seed's men). The seed's normalisation then keeps the state's people
# (demographics_resettle.frontier_seed).
te_demog_frontier_slot = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_age >= 15 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_age <= 19 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_0 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_0 } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_age <= 29 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_1 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_1 } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_age <= 39 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_2 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_2 } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_age <= 49 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_3 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_3 } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_age <= 59 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_4 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_4 } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_fr_5 > 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_dg_m$S$ value = { value = var:te_dg_f$S$ multiply = local_var:te_dg_fr_5 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
